    AI Overview
    George Bush Intercontinental Airport
     (IAH) is a major international hub in Houston, Texas, featuring five terminals (A, B, C, D, E) connected by a train and subway. Major airlines include United Airlines, which uses it as a hub, alongside numerous domestic and international carriers. Due to severe TSA staffing shortages in March 2026, long security lines exceeding 3–4 hours are common, requiring passengers to arrive 3–4 hours early. 
    Key IAH Information (As of March 2026): 
    • Terminals: A, B, C, D, and E. Terminals C, D, and E are heavily utilized for international flights.
    • Airlines: Major airlines operating out of IAH include United, American, Delta, and numerous international carriers.
    • Security Procedures: Due to government shutdowns, severe security staffing shortages exist. Security checkpoints (TSA) can experience 4-hour wait times. TSA PreCheck and CLEAR may not operate, and ICE agents have been deployed to help manage the security areas.
    • Airport Code: IAH.
    • Dining/Amenities: Various options are available, including the new "Taste of Gold" restaurant by Simone Biles in Terminal A.
    • Transportation: METRO bus routes (500 and 102) are available to downtown. 
    Note: Security delays are currently significant (over 3 hours). Always check fly2houston.com for real-time updates..
